text:
CanDrv
calls service
CanIf_TxConfirmation()
. Parameter
CanTxPduId
specifies the
L-PDU
previously transmitted by
Can_Write()
.
CanDrv
must store the all in
HTHs
pending
L-PDU
Ids in an array organized per
HTH
to avoid new search of the
L-PDU
ID for call of
CanIf_TxConfirmation()
.

targets.why: Organization of Tx L-PDUs per HTH
